paite: TOUPA aw, nangmah ah ka ginna ka koih zel a; chik mah chiang in zahlak in hon omsak ke'nla, na diktatna ziak in hon humbit in.
heading: David La / Pathian A Muanna Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

paite: Kei lam ah na bil hon doh inla; hon humbit meng in; kei a ding in suangpi kiptak, hon hotdamna ding in bitna inn hong hi in.
english: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

paite: Nang ka suangpi leh ka kulhpi na hi a; huaiziak in na min ziak in hon pi hon kai in.
english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

paite: Ka awkna dia aguk a alenphah lak uah hon kaikhia in; ka insang na hi ngal a.
english: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

paite: Na khut ah ka kha ka hon kemsak hi. TOUPA thutak Pathian, nang na hon tanta hi.
english: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.

paite: Thil bangpeuh gina lou peuh ngaihtuahte ka hua a; ke'n bel TOUPA ka muang ahi.
english: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.

paite: Na zahngaihna ziak in nuam in ka kipak ding a; ka mangbatna na mu gige hi; ka hinna amangbat lai in na theigige hi.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

paite: Hon doumi khut ah na hon khum kei a; ka khe mun awngthawl ah na nga zawta hi.
english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka tung ah zahngai in, mangbang in ka om ngal a; lungkhamna ziak in ka mit, ahi, ka hinna leh ka pumpi nangawn ase huaihuai hi.
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

paite: Ka damsung lungkhamna in amangbangta ngei a, ka kumte thumna in abeita hi; ka thulimlouhna ziak in ka tha azaw a, ka guhte leng asegawp hi.
english: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

paite: Hon doute ziak in ka min ahong seta a, ahi ka vengte lak ah nakpi in aseta hi, ka meltheihte a ding in leng kihtakhuaipi ka hita hi; kholak a hon mute'n ahon taisanta ngal ua.
english: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

paite: Misi amangngilh bang ngei un mangngilh in ka om a, bel kitam bang lel ka hita hi.
english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

paite: Mi tampi hon hekna ka za ngal a, kil chih ah mulkimna a-om hi. Kei kalh a akisawmkhawm lai un, ka hinna hon laksak atum uhi.
english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, ka hon muang a; ka Pathian na hi ka chi hi.
english: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”

paite: Ka hunte na khut ah a-om a, hon doute khut a kipan leh hon simmohte lak ah hon humbit in.
english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

paite: Na mel in na sikha hon sunvak in; na zahngaihna ziak in hon hondam in.
english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

paite: TOUPA aw, zahlak in hon omsak ke'n; ka hon sam ngal a; migilou-salou zahlak in om uhen, Sheol ah dai dinden in om uhen.
english: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

paite: Muk zuautheite pau thei lou in om uhen; huaite'n kisathei leh musit kawm in pautaltak in midiktatte agense zel uhi.
english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

paite: Na hoihna, nangmah laudan siamte a ding a na kholkhawm thupi na tel e! Mihing tate mitmuh a muanna koihte a ding a na hihsak pentak.
english: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

paite: Amau mihing omna lak ah na humbitna na mitmuh in na selgu dia; lei selhatna lak ah bukta ah na koih gu ding hi.
english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

paite: TOUPA phat in om hen; achitdan lamdangtak khopi kiptak ah ahon musak ngal a.
english: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

paite: Kei lah, hamhaih in, na mitmuh a pan paihmang in ka omta, ka na chi maimah hi; himahleh ka hon sap a hehpihna ka hon ngetna awte na na za hi.
english: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

paite: Amisiangthou tengtengte aw, TOUPA it un; TOUPA'N miginom ahumbit a, kisatheitak a gamta nakpitak in athuk zel hi.
english: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

paite: TOUPA lamen tengtengte aw, hattak in om unla, na lungtang uh hangsak un.
english: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
